errors.text_span: und ist mit seinem jeweiligen numerischen Wert beschriftet;
errors.evidence: Only three bars (2008, 2014, 2021) are labeled with their numerical values. The description incorrectly states that each of the 14 bars is labeled.

errors.text_span: wobei die Balkenhöhen visuell den jährlichen Zuwachs widerspiegeln
errors.evidence: The height of each bar represents the absolute number of FEUs for that year, corresponding to the y-axis scale. It does not represent the annual increase ('jährlichen Zuwachs'); the increase is represented by the difference in height between consecutive bars.
